purpose: Characterize why the previously observed CONTRADICTORY state outperformed without promoting that observation to a certified edge on the already-seen sample.
core_question: When local-minus-USD 2Y repricing contradicts the contemporaneously known relative macro impulse, is the information primarily coming from rates leading macro, from temporary macro-rate dislocation, or from a non-robust sample effect?

frozen_inputs.macro_inputs: exact corrected canonical PIT streams used by PR129
frozen_inputs.frequency: monthly OOS observation grid inherited from PR122

divergence_definition.front_end_sign: sign(change in local-minus-USD 2Y differential at t)
divergence_definition.inflation_pressure_sign: sign(change in latest-known local inflation impulse minus change in latest-known USD inflation impulse)
divergence_definition.labour_pressure_sign: sign(-(change in latest-known local unemployment impulse minus change in latest-known USD unemployment impulse))
divergence_definition.contradictory_state: neither macro pressure supports the non-zero front-end sign and at least one macro pressure opposes it

predeclared_subtypes.DOUBLE_OPPOSITION: inflation and labour pressure are both non-zero and both opposite the front-end sign
predeclared_subtypes.INFLATION_ONLY_OPPOSITION: inflation pressure is opposite the front-end sign and labour pressure is zero
predeclared_subtypes.LABOUR_ONLY_OPPOSITION: labour pressure is opposite the front-end sign and inflation pressure is zero
predeclared_subtypes.OTHER_CONTRADICTORY: contradictory under the parent contract but not one of the three mutually exclusive subtypes above

lead_lag_characterization.metric: subsequent FX return signed by current front-end repricing direction
lead_lag_characterization.purpose: test whether rates direction tends to lead subsequent FX during contradiction
lead_lag_characterization.note: exploratory only on this already-observed history

persistence_characterization.definition: whether the front-end repricing sign remains the same at the next OOS observation

interpretation_rules.cross_currency_consistency_required_befo: at least 3 of 4 currencies must point in the same qualitative direction
interpretation_rules.candidate_generation_only: If a coherent mechanism appears, write a separate confirmatory contract before looking at any future OOS validation results.

future_confirmatory_stage.sample: strictly unseen observations after the discovery cutoff

minimum_candidate_requirements_before_fo.no_single_currency_contribution_dominanc: no one currency may contribute more than 50% of candidate observations

future_confirmatory_stage.production_promotion: forbidden until a separate predeclared unseen-data gate passes
